headers.//: HTML pages always revalidate — never serve a stale shell that points at old assets. All marketing pages are at the root, so *.html (not **/*.html, whose **/ wants a directory and skips root index.html).

Vanilla scene scripts have STABLE (unhashed) URLs, so they must revalidate on every load or a bug fix can sit behind a day-old cache. Vite's own bundle (main-<hash>.js / *.css) is content-hashed and safe to cache long.
